purpose: Deterministic functional comparison of correction, withdrawal, strong dependencies, CAS, isolation and logical snapshot recovery. No process-kill, power-loss, concurrent-client, latency or general-product superiority claim.

retained_authority.restore: Restore only content from S0; current heads, tombstones and durable events remain outside that snapshot.

snapshot_local.restore: Restore both content and local authority from S0, with no retained external freshness evidence made available to the implementation.
snapshot_local.oracle: Safety is still measured exclusively against expect. expect_by_profile describes the known mechanically predictable rollback result and never converts unsafe reads into safety passes.

oracle_contract.independence: Expectations are authored from synthetic logical events and content before backend execution. No backend/core import or backend-generated expected value is used. Adapters receive operation arguments only, never expect, expect_error or expect_by_profile.
oracle_contract.references: Operation as fields bind backend-generated references or checkpoints to fixture-local symbols. Symbols are not backend IDs. A0/A1 are distinct versions of source A; B0 is an independent source. Bindings survive logical reopen and restore.
oracle_contract.documentary_content: Q04 content comes entirely from B0; A0 is documentary only. There is no hidden derivation of C from the revoked A0 content.
oracle_contract.external_current_truth: The fixture event sequence remains the external current-state oracle across every restore. Replaying an old full snapshot never rewinds the oracle.
oracle_contract.snapshot_rollback_limit: If all authority is rolled back and no external freshness evidence exists, the local implementation cannot distinguish that snapshot from its legitimate old state. Restored exposures are unsafe-relative-current-event and the known architecture ablation, not proof of universal SQLite/RAG failure.
oracle_contract.quarantine: After restore and before verify_restore, reads are denied without text. This is expected quarantine, not an unjustified block. The subsequent checkpoint is read from the active backend, never secretly substituted by the external oracle.
oracle_contract.missing_current: Q10 A1 remains unavailable because its content is absent from S0; old A0 is not an acceptable replacement. After reconciliation B0 must be available.
oracle_contract.exact_content: Allowed reads must contain exactly expect.text, including accents, Unicode punctuation and spacing. Denied reads must not serve non-null text, even if an allowed flag is false. No substring, byte-count-only or judge-model decision substitutes for these checks.
oracle_contract.expected_errors: Only a rejected operation with the declared semantic error is expected. Arbitrary SQLite errors, exceptions, missing outputs and infrastructure failures are unexpected, never accepted as CAS or safety rejections.
oracle_contract.late_publication: Q06/Q07 each try both an old checkpoint and a fresh checkpoint with an invalid old dependency. Rejections alone are insufficient: each trace also preserves or publishes a valid independent/current control.
oracle_contract.idempotent_replay: Q06 captures a checkpoint after withdrawal, replays the same withdrawal event, then successfully publishes independent B0 content using that checkpoint. Replay must not introduce a second semantic event or invalidate this prepared current control.
oracle_contract.scope_limit: Q12 tests equal IDs in different workspaces, cross-workspace derivation rejection and scoped withdrawal. It does not claim principal ACL enforcement by read(ref), which has no principal argument.
oracle_contract.logical_reopen: reopen is a normal close/open without fault injection. It is not a crash or durability stress test.
oracle_contract.denominators: Each expected read/write checkpoint is one declared opportunity. Preserve per-case observations and separate every metric; do not compute an aggregate success score or treat seeded variants/repetitions as independent users.

variant_generation.method: Python standard-library random.Random(20261022) shuffles the ten declared tree labels, then draws each depth with randrange(1,4). CAS winner order alternates by variant index, five left and five right. Payload templates are fully materialized in this file. No model, network, environment or private memory contributes content.
